<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ent "<!ENTITY internal 'parsed entity text'>">
  %ent;
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY ext SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns" xmlns:sub="http://example.com/sub">
  <!-- Comment containing a PI-like string <?pi test?> and entity &internal; -->
  <sub:child sub:id="1">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA block with <tags> & internal references inside.
    ]]>
    &internal;
  </sub:child>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ent1 "First Entity">
  <!ENTITY ent2 "&ent1; and Second">
  <!ENTITY % param "<!ENTITY ent3 'Parameter-driven entity'>">
  %param;
]>
<?xml-target processing="instruction" data="value"?>
<catalog xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Top level comment before CDATA -->
  <item xlink:type="simple">
    <![CDATA[
      Some raw CDATA content with <markup> and &ent3;
    ]]>
    &ent2;
  </item>
</catalog>
```

  <!ELEMENT file (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY file-ent "FileEntityContent">
  <!ENTITY % p-ent "<!ENTITY file-param 'ParamContent'>">

    ]]>
    &file-ent;
  </arc:file>
</archive>

]>

    &sec-ent;
  </doc:section>
</document>
